column8: Haven't seen any. Closest they've come is having a wine maker or sales rep fpr a winery come in and really dig into. For example Sake, recently tasted that. We usually flag the wines that they for tastings then those usually sell out. Don't get a lot of targeted marketing stuff. More national newsletters that do that. How have themarketing efforts changed at wine mine - dipping toe in water with uber eats. Don't know how the sales are going on that. Still foguring out what they want to do with that. It feels like they could show something like recent satursday tastings - more task oriented rather than type of wine. as that gets tricky fast. Classifications can go wrong.  Categories they've been playing around with: this is what we tasted last sat, this is what we do this week. Sometimes themes, rose tastings in the summer etc. A lot of their inventory is online and it's not easy to maintain but figuring out ways to do that that would be useful to people and not drive them crazy
